description: Implementation of ProductRelationshipService handling CRUD operations, group management, and retrieval of product relationships in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing business logic for managing product relationships, including group management and retrieval based on various criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a ProductRelationship based on its ID.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Adds a new product relationship group for a store.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all groups for a store.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes all relationships in a specified group.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Deactivates all relationships in a specified group.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Activates all relationships in a specified group.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific ProductRelationship after re-fetching it.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Lists all relationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships by type, store, product, and language.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships by group name, store, and optionally language.
